text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (May 22, 2025) for 146 Jameson Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (May 22, 2025) for 146 Jameson Avenue, Folder Number PRS 25 162672 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to April 30, 2026. 2. Modified the Property Standards Order (May 22, 2025) for 146 Jameson Avenue, Folder Number PRS 25 162672 00 IV, to read as follows: By-lay Section Location and Description Required Action 19 . D .(3) (b ) Throughout Building - stairwells: Height of the guard for the exit stairs are less than 1,070 millimetres around landings.
